svg.title: Maritime Southeast Asia · encounters and independence
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Separate precolonial encounters and cultural reception are shown alongside the colonial-to-independent state sequence. There is no asserted Srivijaya→Majapahit→Indonesia governmental lineage. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
